all_cases: Response must contain at least one expected entity
SQL validation query must return expected row count
Evidence provenance must cite correct source per field
Ranking weights must remain frozen (constraint 0.5 / academic 0.25 / preference 0.15 / evidence 0.10)
graph_cases: Graph traversal must follow correct relationship direction
Through-train queries must return both primary and secondary schools
Feeder queries must distinguish feeder vs nominated
admission_cases: Net-based logic must be explicit (not distance-based)
Primary net → Secondary net linkage must be correct
District → Net mapping must use POA data
evidence_cases: KG vacancy must use latest snapshot_date
Profile evidence must cite EDB_SSP/EDB_PSP/EDB_KGP/CHSC source
ambiguous_cases: Agent MUST NOT auto-recommend when entity is ambiguous
Agent MUST ask clarification with options
Agent MUST list all matching entities
